title: Tmux 使用教程
chinese_title: Tmux 终端复用器使用指南
list_summary_zh: Tmux终端复用器教程：会话分离、窗格管理和快捷键操作指南
feynman_summary:
Tmux is a terminal multiplexer that detaches sessions from windows, allowing processes to run continuously in the background. It enables managing multiple sessions, splitting panes, and switching windows efficiently through keyboard shortcuts.

The core workflow involves creating a named session, running programs, detaching with Ctrl+b d, and reattaching later. Key features include horizontal/vertical pane splitting, cursor navigation between panes, and window management. Unlike standard terminals, Tmux preserves sessions even when connections drop, making it ideal for remote development.
chinese_translation: Tmux 是一款终端复用工具，能将会话与窗口分离，使进程在后台持续运行。它支持多会话管理、窗格分割和窗口切换，通过快捷键提高操作效率。基本流程包括创建会话、运行程序、分离会话和重新连接。Tmux 还提供窗格划分、光标移动和窗口重命名等功能，是开发者提升终端效率的实用工具。
